milestones.description: Complete at least one new cot after setup.
Complete at least one new outhouse after setup.
Complete at least one new wash basin after setup.
Complete at least one new mess table after setup.
Complete at least one new storage bin after setup.
Complete at least one new ration box after setup.
Complete at least one new ladder after setup.
Complete at least one new floor tile after setup.
Complete at least one new pneumatic door after setup.
Complete at least one new pitcher pump after setup.
Complete at least one new research station after setup.
Complete at least one new super computer after setup.
Complete at least one new manual generator after setup.
Complete at least one new coal generator after setup.
Complete at least one new any supported battery after setup.
Complete at least one new electrical wire after setup.
Complete at least one new oxygen diffuser after setup.
Complete at least one new refrigerator.
Complete at least one new electrolyzer after setup.
Complete at least one new planter box after setup.
Produce 10000 J of new electricity.
Produce 20 kg of new oxygen.
Produce 1000 kcal of new food.
Preserve positive charge in a new battery.
Consume 1000 J of new energy in consumers.
Establish three new cultivated supported edible crops.
Manufacture 1000 kcal of new food, excluding raw harvests.
Build a new liquid pump and increase water in conduits.
Complete two new technologies.
Increase supported loose or stored refined metal by 100 kg.
Complete four technologies including one requiring advanced research.
Complete one new Gas Pump and one new Gas Filter.
Complete one new Liquid Reservoir and increase water mass in liquid conduits by at least 100 kg over setup. Water need not be attributed to that reservoir.
Complete one new Electric Grill and manufacture at least 4000 kcal of new food colony-wide. The production is not attributed to that grill.
Generate 50000 J with a new coal generator.
Complete one new Water Sieve and one new Liquid Pump. Construction only; processing volume is not claimed.
Complete one new Rock Crusher and increase supported loose or stored refined-metal inventory by at least 200 kg. Manufacturing provenance is not required.
Complete one new Lavatory and one new Sink. Construction only; plumbing connectivity and use are not claimed.
Preserve at least 10000 J in one newly completed Smart Battery.
Establish at least three new cultivated crops of each of two distinct supported edible plant types. Wild and initially cultivated plants do not count.
Generate at least 100000 J after setup using newly built supported native electricity generators of any type. Initial generators and debug devices do not count.
Preserve at least two newly completed Smart Batteries with combined stored energy of at least 20000 J.
Complete one new large Power Transformer and at least ten new Conductive Wire segments. Construction only; connectivity and downstream flow are not claimed.
Complete one new Exosuit Forge, two new Atmo Suit Docks and one new Atmo Suit Checkpoint. Filled suits or connected oxygen supply are not required.
Increase loose or stored steel inventory by at least 100 kg over setup. Building-embedded material is excluded.
Complete six new Hydroponic Farm tiles and establish six new cultivated Bristle Blossoms. Placement in those particular tiles and irrigation history are not claimed.
Complete one new Grooming Station, Critter Feeder, Critter Drop-Off and Incubator. Construction only; room membership, taming and grooming are not claimed.
Complete one new Thermo Sensor, one new Gas Pressure Sensor and ten new Automation Wire segments. Construction only; connectivity and switching history are not claimed.
Increase loose or stored plastic inventory by at least 100 kg over setup. Building-embedded material is excluded.
Complete at least eight new technologies, including three requiring advanced research.
